hero.badge: Built Specifically for Indian Small Business Owners
hero.subheading: MSME-BIOS reads your handwritten bills and bank statements, tracks cash flow daily, and delivers actionable intelligence so you can run your enterprise on real numbers, not guesswork.

features.heading: Everything you need to run your business, in one place
features.subheading: Designed specifically to take paperwork off your plate so you can focus on growing sales.

documentParser.title: Document Digitization
documentParser.description: Turns bank statements, invoices, and handwritten bills into structured records automatically using AI vision.

cashDashboard.title: Business Tracking
cashDashboard.description: Live view of cash flow, daily revenue, bank balances, and P&L statements updated as transactions happen.

invoiceGenerator.title: Invoice Generation
invoiceGenerator.description: Create compliant, professional invoices with correct CGST/SGST splits ready to send to customers.

indiaLocalized.title: Built for India
indiaLocalized.description: Supports handwritten paper bills, local GST regulations, vernacular bill formats, and WhatsApp notifications.

howItWorks.heading: How MSME-BIOS Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Snap a picture of handwritten bills or upload PDF bank statements in seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI extracts line items, GST splits, vendor names, and totals automatically.
howItWorks.step3Desc: See cash balances, P&L statements, and customer dues updated in real-time.

pricing.heading: Pick a plan, or build your own
pricing.subheading: Transparent pricing designed to scale with your business turnover.
pricing.customDescription: Select individual modules and watch your price update in real-time.

msmeBanner.heading: Is your business officially an MSME?
msmeBanner.description: Registration is completely free, takes about 10 minutes, and unlocks collateral-free bank loans, lower interest rates, and protection against delayed customer payments.
